basic_info.description: First time on the market in nearly 50 years! Extremely rare, semi-detached, single story, single family home in prime Central Sunset location. Two blocks to Golden Gate Park and Irving corridor shops and restaurants. The main house consists of 2 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, living room with wood burning fireplace, formal dining room and kitchen with stainless steel appliances. Original hardwood floors, period details and windows on four sides. Sunny center courtyard is perfect for gardening, grilling and relaxing. Additional 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom bonus space with separate entrance and its own side yard. Large, one car garage and spacious basement with plenty of storage. Unbeatable location, walking distance to groceries, restaurants and shops. Enjoy the outdoors with Golden Gate Park and Ocean Beach, just minutes away. Easy commute on the N-Judah, Muni bus lines, 19th Ave, Lincoln and Crossover. Come see this exceptionally unique property with endless possibilities and potential!
